plan.rationale: Parent discovery shows 13 bucket allreduces per step (12x28,351,488B + 1x157,541,376B, f32 SUM) already attributed via observed gradient-storage membership, with rank-0 NCCL kernel durations ~4x rank-1 at identical payloads (e.g. 13.8ms vs 3.6ms per 28MB bucket, plus a 114ms first-bucket outlier) - the objective is waiting-inclusive, and peer_access is disabled in both directions. All three parameter_screening candidates reduced communication_kernel_sum_ms (parent max-rank ~284.7ms down to 60-87ms) yet every one violates the step_ms constraint (227.0/276.9/264.4ms vs limit 151.86ms, original reference 144.63ms), so the decisive uncertainty is not the comm number itself but where the extra ~82-132ms of step wall time sits: relocated wait in the sync_wait path, framework binding overhead, or communication serialized against compute. I target revision 560d64a468acf7c63d3e5eee7f714a24dd8b3ad869c9e5b8ee98a7df04b4ab44 (sync_wait_budget_ms=250), which is closest to feasibility on both metrics (step 227.0ms, comm max 71.35ms), making its residual excess the most actionable question. binding_cost is applicable (an additive legacy-bound candidate exists with functional_sites=2 and zero framework fallbacks) and splits whole-invocation cost between parent and binding-only passthrough to separate framework overhead from candidate-intrinsic cost. execution_timeline records the candidate's synchronization events and CPU-to-CUDA submit associations with clock-alignment bounds to expose host-side waiting without replacing any communication hook. nsys (available per request.json tools) supplies the GPU-side timeline to check whether the shortened NCCL kernels are now serialized with or displaced from compute. nccl_tuning captures the actual NCCL algorithm/protocol/channel decisions at the observed sizes/dtypes in a separate warmed worker, since kernel entry names alone do not identify the protocol. collective_calibration provides a correctness-checked synthetic full-world SUM allreduce reference at exactly the observed 28,351,488B and 157,541,376B sizes to gauge how much of the measured kernel duration is algorithm cost versus waiting - as a reference, not a lower bound or critical-path estimate. torch is omitted because it already ran and evaluation.json carries its per-rank fields; device_telemetry is omitted because its device-wide NVML windows cannot attribute per-collective traffic; python_runtime is omitted because its perturbed inclusive/self times are not clean scores; candidate_diagnostics has no capability or trace evidence supporting a specific uncertainty here.

plan.rationale: All three sync_wait_budget_ms candidates reduced the objective (max-rank communication_kernel_sum_ms 94.49 -> 71.35 at 250 ms, 76.65 at 500 ms, 86.97 at 2000 ms) while every one violated the step_ms constraint (227.04/276.86/264.36 vs limit 151.86, original reference 144.63), so decision was no_valid_parameter_candidate. Select the Pareto-best revision 560d64a468acf7c63d3e5eee7f714a24dd8b3ad869c9e5b8ee98a7df04b4ab44 (sync_wait_budget_ms=250: lowest step_ms and lowest objective) and resolve two uncertainties. (1) Attribution of the +82 ms step regression: it must not be assumed to be algorithm cost - the comm-sum rank asymmetry flips sign across budgets (500 ms: rank0 76.6 > rank1 64.0; 2000 ms: rank1 87.0 > rank0 60.2; 250 ms: rank1 71.3 > rank0 61.0) and the parent trace shows waiting-dominated kernels, so execution_timeline is requested for per-device intervals, CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization events and passive post-accumulate callbacks (CPU clock bounds only), and binding_cost is requested because the additive legacy binding (functional_sites 2, framework_fallbacks 0) could itself account for whole-invocation cost via clean AB/BA parent-vs-passthrough; reference invocations (13/13 coverage) may be verification or composition, not fallback. (2) Headroom of the communication objective itself: collective_calibration gives a warmed synthetic full-world SUM allreduce reference at the actually observed sizes (12 x 28351488 B f32 plus 1 x 157541376 B f32) with correctness checks to separate intrinsic SHM-fabric cost from arrival-skew waiting (a reference experiment, not a lower bound or critical-path estimate), and nccl_tuning records the actual NCCL algorithm/protocol/channel decisions at those sizes since kernel entry names alone (RING_LL) do not identify the protocol. Excluded: torch (already ran - observations.json and per-candidate communication_kernel_sum_ms exist), nsys (cannot separate NCCL waiting from wire transfer nor prove bucket identity; attribution is covered by execution_timeline), device_telemetry (device-wide NVML rates with native windows, no per-collective attribution; peer_access 0), python_runtime (perturbs execution; host dispatch not yet implicated by evidence), candidate_diagnostics (no capability or trace evidence describes its outputs).
